fonte: Los Angeles County Public Works (annexation records); Homer Hamlin, City Engineer (1916)
legenda: 18.64 sq mi in all; the thin part, less than half, about half a mile wide and about 15 miles long in 1906.
texto_para_tela: 18.64 SQ MI · thin part: less than half the area · ABOUT HALF A MILE · ABOUT 15 MILES (1906) · Torrance · 1921 · Gardena · 1930 · Lomita · 1964 · Carson · 1968
credito_tela: Source: Los Angeles County annexation records
nota: Classe inteira dos vizinhos de hoje (amostra de 14 pontos, sin.num-05): Gardena, Carson, Torrance, Lomita e terra do condado; Long Beach (1897) não encosta. Nenhum deles era cidade em 1906. As áreas da faixa fina e do bloco são da geometria do condado (8,63 + 9,96 = 18,59), não do registro.
narracao: The whole annexation was more than eighteen square miles. But the thin part is less than half of that; the rest is a wide block up north. The thin part is about half a mile wide. On the outline of 1906, before the city grew around both ends, the strip ran about fifteen miles from north to south, all of it across county land. The towns that line it today weren't cities yet. Look at the tip.
